1238.commentary: (SNa) ajjasaṭṭhiṃ na dissantī'ti ajja chadivasamattakā paṭṭhāya na dissanti. (SNt) ajjasaṭṭhin'ti ajja channaṃ pūraṇī saṭṭhī divasavutti, ajja ādiṃ katvā cha divase'ti attho. accantasaṃyoge c'etaṃ upayogavacanaṃ. ajja chadivasamattakā'ti ajjato chaṭṭhadivasamattakā.

khayaṃ virāgaṃ amataṃ paṇītaṃ, yad'ajjhagā sakyamunī samāhito. na tena dhammena sam'atthi kiñci

na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigiṃse, desso hoti atiyācanāya, nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena, adassanaṃ'y'eva tadajjhagamā'ti.
